children: Norwegian Air Shuttle said Monday that its Wideroe regional airline will expand its fleet with two new Embraer E195-E2 aircraft.
The new aircraft, which are scheduled for delivery in the first quarter of 2028, will bring Wideroe's jet fleet to five aircraft, alongside its existing 47 De Havilland Dash 8 turboprop aircraft.
The aircraft will be delivered directly from Embraer and will strengthen Wideroe's network between Bergen, Trondheim and Northern Norway.
